intervals.label: VEPP-2M data taking
intervals.locator: Silagadze, essay on the SND site, section I; SND General Info ("SND is taking its data since 1995")
intervals.quote: An improved version of the neutral detector — the spherical neutral detector (SND) [4] — operated at the VEPP2M collider in 1995-2000.

intervals.label: upgrade for VEPP-2000
intervals.locator: Silagadze, essay on the SND site, section I
intervals.note: VEPP-2M was modernised into VEPP-2000 after 2000; the first VEPP-2000 season with SND was 2009/2010 (Berkaev et al.).
intervals.quote: SND was also upgraded for experiments at this new collider [5] and it operates at VEPP-2000 since 2010.
